title: Reply to State Pollution Control Board Show Cause / Closure Notice under Water Act, Air Act & EP Act
whenToUse: Use when an industrial manufacturing plant receives a proposed closure notice or show cause notice under Section 33A Water Act or Section 31A Air Act from the State Pollution Board.
variantComparisonNote: Administrative defense reply and corrective action plan before Pollution Control Board. Distinct from original application before NGT.
youWillNeed: Valid Consent to Operate (CTO), ETP/STP logbooks, third-party NABL lab test results, continuous emission monitoring system (CEMS) data logs.
legalBasis: Section 33A Water Act, 1974; Section 31A Air Act, 1981; Environment (Protection) Act, 1986.
mandatoryStatutoryIngredients: Subsisting Consent to Operate (CTO) valid and operational
Point-by-point rebuttal of inspection team observations with NABL laboratory test certificates
Comprehensive Corrective Action Plan (CAP) with time-bound milestones
Statutory prayer for personal hearing before Technical Committee prior to adverse closure order

aiBlocks.title: Preliminary Submissions & Existing Consents
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Narrate compliance history of {{FACT:industrial_unit_name}}, valid CTO, investment in advanced pollution control devices, and green belt development.

aiBlocks.title: Technical Rebuttal & Corrective Action Plan
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Provide point-wise technical reply to SCN No. {{FACT:spcb_scn_number}}, attach NABL lab reports showing parameters within limits, and detail operational ETP/STP protocols.

aiBlocks.title: Prayer for Withdrawal of Notice & Personal Hearing
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Draft prayer to drop proposed closure / revocation of CTO, confirm continued operation, and grant personal hearing before the Technical Advisory Committee.
